product: A responsive planning diary for shaping each day, reflecting each evening, and setting weekly goals with progress reports.
audience: Russian- and English-speaking people who plan focused work on desktop and check or update their plans on mobile.
platform: responsive web for desktop and mobile
direction: grounded in nature, history, paper, and oak

foundations.accentDirection: muted leafy green for primary actions, supported by warm oak and paper; dark wood in dark theme
foundations.contrast: legible, high-contrast text and clear keyboard focus against nuanced paper and wood surfaces
foundations.typographyCharacter: Literata for diary-like editorial headings and reflective copy; Manrope for interface controls, labels, and numerals; both with Cyrillic support
foundations.dominantRadius: small-to-medium, natural corners without pill-heavy styling
foundations.surfaceModel: layered paper and oak surfaces with restrained material grain and a dark-wood counterpart in dark theme
foundations.borders: quiet, warm hairlines with stronger edges for focus and state
foundations.elevation: soft tactile separation, pressed depth on controls, and no heavy floating shadows
foundations.motionIntensity: short, restrained tactile interaction feedback; reduced-motion aware

components: day plan with time blocks, tasks, and completion states
evening review with reflective writing and daily highlights

componentTreatments.Button: Tactile paper-and-oak depth with a clear, short pressed response; retain clear hover, focus, disabled, and loading states.
componentTreatments.Input: Paper-like inset surface, legible placeholder and value, and a strong accessible focus ring.
componentTreatments.Textarea: Warm writing surface with a calm tactile edge and a highly visible focus state.
componentTreatments.Card: Layered paper surfaces and restrained oak-like shadow; interactive cards lift subtly and press clearly.
componentTreatments.Checkbox: Distinctive tactile state change with an unmistakable checked mark and keyboard focus.
componentTreatments.Switch: Clear thumb movement and state contrast without relying on motion or color alone.
componentTreatments.Select: Tactile trigger and readable menu surfaces with a clear active and focused option.
componentTreatments.Tabs: A quiet, physical-feeling selected state with direct keyboard navigation.
componentTreatments.Dialog: Layered paper surface with restrained entrance feedback and reliable focus handling.
componentTreatments.Slider: Readable track, tactile thumb, and strong keyboard and focus feedback.
componentTreatments.FileUpload: A tactile native file-selection surface with clear hover, focus, disabled, and error states; preserve browser file semantics.

motionScenarios: Short physical feedback for interactive controls, selection, completion, and surface hover/press states.
Do not implement zooming transitions between page sections in the design system; section reveals and page composition belong to the application.
All motion respects prefers-reduced-motion and preserves immediate, understandable state changes.
productCompositions: A responsive day-planning page with time blocks, quick task entry, completion, and an empty-day state.
An evening review with a generous writing area, daily highlights, and saved/error feedback.
A weekly goals and report view with progress, a readable summary, and a no-activity state.
responsiveRequirements: Keep primary planning actions easy to reach on narrow mobile screens without horizontal scrolling.
Reflow weekly summaries and tables for mobile while preserving clear labels and values.
Maintain readable writing areas, control targets, and keyboard access at every width.
typographyRequirements: Use Literata for distinctive journal-like headings while preserving clear line lengths and hierarchy.
Use Manrope for controls, labels, utility copy, and aligned tabular numerals.
Support Russian and English text, including Cyrillic glyphs and natural wrapping.
stateScenarios: An empty day before the user adds a plan.
Saving a plan or review, including successful confirmation and retryable failure.
Completed, in-progress, and overdue tasks with distinguishable non-color-only states.
A week with no goals yet and a populated weekly report.

decisionNotes.note: The system serves a Russian- and English-language responsive planning diary across day planning, evening reflection, and weekly goals.
The user approved warm paper, oak, muted green, tactile depth, and dark wood in dark mode, while requiring modern, readable actions.
The user delegated the precise shade selection within the approved warm paper, oak, muted green, and dark-wood direction; contrast and focus remain mandatory.
The user selected Literata for diary character and Manrope for interface and numbers, both with Cyrillic support.
Tactile feedback belongs to component implementations, while zooming section transitions and page composition remain application-owned.
Implement all required and optional shared contracts in one visual language and do not add custom extensions.

avoid: decorative historical ornament that competes with writing or actions
heavy shadows, glass effects, or glossy wood imitation
pill-heavy controls and overly rounded cards
page-level zoom transitions or application-specific compositions in the package
language-specific layouts that fail with Russian or English content
